# Accessibility Checklist: Design directions for the portfolio

**Purpose**: Validate that the accessibility requirements (WCAG 2.2 AA, reduced motion, no JavaScript) are complete, clear and measurable.
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command. It tests the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Standard and Scope

- [ ] CHK001 Is WCAG 2.2 AA named as the standard for every page type the feature adds (three story pages, three indexes)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the exact states that must be checked enumerated (theme x width x reduced motion x JavaScript off) rather than left as "including"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Is "zero violations" defined against a named tool and rule set, and is it stated what happens to rules that need manual judgement? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the "phone" and "desktop" widths pinned to specific values rather than "representative widths"? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the constitution's accessibility (Principle X) and static-by-default (Principle V) obligations traced to specific requirements? [Traceability, Spec §User Story 3]

## Reduced Motion

- [ ] CHK006 Is "movement-based reveal animation" defined precisely enough to say whether fades or opacity changes are allowed under reduced motion? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK007 Are reduced-motion requirements stated for every motion source (reveals, demo clips, theme switch, filter changes, option comparison), not only reveals and clips? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the fallback for a demo clip under reduced motion (still frame and text description) consistent between the edge cases and FR-016? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it specified that reduced motion is honoured at load and when the preference changes mid-visit? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the requirement that "nothing stays hidden" measurable, by naming what counts as hidden content? [Measurability, Spec §User Story 3]

## No JavaScript

- [ ] CHK011 Is the no-JavaScript requirement consistent across the story page (FR-017), the index (FR-023) and User Story 3? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the required no-JavaScript behaviour of the option comparison defined for each direction's comparison pattern? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the no-JavaScript state of the theme filter defined (all entries shown, and whether the filter control is hidden or inert)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the no-JavaScript state of the demo embed defined (link and description only)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the no-JavaScript state of the theme switch specified, given both themes must be reviewable? [Gap]

## Perceivable Content

- [ ] CHK016 Are text alternatives required for every diagram, placeholder frame and clip, and is their minimum content described? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK017 Are colour contrast requirements stated for both themes, including status badges and theme tags that may rely on colour alone? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 Is it required that status (shipped, experiment, in progress) is conveyed by more than colour? [Gap, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK019 Are reflow and zoom requirements (320 px, 200% text) stated, given the spec only says "no horizontal scrolling"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the requirement for wide comparison content (tables, diagrams) to remain reachable at phone width specific about how, since page-level scrolling is banned? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Operable and Understandable

- [ ] CHK021 Are keyboard operation requirements defined for the theme filter, option comparison and demo controls? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK022 Are focus visibility and focus-not-obscured requirements stated for sticky or overlaid story elements? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 Is a heading structure requirement stated for the seven stages, and is the heading level consistent across directions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK024 Are announcements for filter results (including the "no projects match" message) required for assistive technology users? [Gap, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK025 Is target size (WCAG 2.2 minimum) specified for filter controls, option tabs and the invitation control? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements for a link that lands mid-story (focus, visibility, reveal state) specified beyond "visible immediately"? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the behaviour of a theme switch mid-story defined for focus and scroll position? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 Are "draft for review" and placeholder labels required to be perceivable by assistive technology and not only as visual badges? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, §FR-012]

## Edge Cases and Dependencies

- [ ] CHK029 Are accessibility requirements defined for the embedded demo (title, keyboard trap avoidance, fallback when blocked)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK030 Are forced-colours and print requirements addressed or explicitly excluded? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the assumption that automated checks alone demonstrate WCAG conformance stated, with the manual checks that fill the gap? [Assumption, Spec §SC-003]
